findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_takeoff_status, list_projects, get_takeoff, export_reviewed_estimate · Private data: get_takeoff, attach_plan_pdf · Public sink: preflight_takeoff, create_project · Destructive: get_takeoff_status, create_project, run_takeoff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_takeoff_status, list_projects, get_takeoff, export_reviewed_estimate · Private data: get_takeoff, attach_plan_pdf · Public sink: preflight_takeoff, create_project · Destructive: get_takeoff_status, create_project, run_takeoff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
